column1: # Rules read by scripts/doctidy.py. Validate with: doctidy.py --check-rules
# One row per rule, TAB-separated; lines starting with # are comments.
#   id        unique within the file; a row in rules.local.tsv with the same id
#             replaces this row, and strength `off` disables it
#   kind      byproduct | historical      class signals (scope name|title|head|path)
#             root-allow                   documents a repository root may keep (name)
#             archive-dir                  retired material; strong = a move target (dir)
#             backup-dir                   kept reference, never a move target (dir)
#             plan-placeholder             example plan names, not references (slug)
#             status-done | status-open    completion signals in plans and status files (line)
#   strength  strong = enough on its own; weak = needs a second independent signal; off
#   regex     Python re, compiled with IGNORECASE. It must run on Python 3.10:
#             no atomic groups, no possessive quantifiers, no global inline flags
#   example   must match its own regex; counter = ;;-separated values that must NOT
#             match. Both go through the same normalisation the scan uses:
#               name   file name -> camelCase split, casefold, [ _.] -> -, then the
#                      language suffix, dates and a leading ordinal are stripped
#               title, head, line   emphasis and backticks removed, spaces collapsed;
#                      head = the first 60 non-empty lines, matched one line at a time
#               dir    one path segment, casefolded;  path  casefolded;  slug  as written
#   note      shown next to every hit
